purpose: Compare the composite against the 124% sector ensemble on matched windows, because the dashboard reports a trailing 52-week figure and the composite work reported a full-history figure, and Step 194 already caught this project making exactly that comparison error once.

methodology_correction_recorded.error: The first attempt built the composite on the intersection of all five books' dates. The daily-audited book is missing seven weeks, three of which fall inside the trailing 52-week window, so requiring all five present shifted the window start from 2025-08-15 to 2025-07-25 and silently discarded three weeks of the incumbent's own returns. It produced 113.94% for a book whose dashboard reports 124.20%.
methodology_correction_recorded.fix: Evaluate on the incumbent's own 188-week calendar and average whichever sleeves reported in a given week. A sleeve failing to report is not a reason to skip the week for every other sleeve.
methodology_correction_recorded.verification: The incumbent now reconciles to 124.20% trailing and -8.71% maximum drawdown, matching its dashboard tile exactly.
methodology_correction_recorded.residual_caveat: A three-book variant excluding the gapped sleeve entirely is reported alongside, so the gap-filling choice can be seen not to drive the conclusion.

windows.trailing_52w: 2025-08-15 to 2026-08-07, the incumbent's own retrospective holdout window

comparators: equal-weight composite of all five books
equal-weight composite of four books, excluding the Micron growth book per Step 209
equal-weight composite of three books, excluding the gapped sleeve as a robustness check
four-book composite blended with the cross-asset trend sleeve at 20, 30 and 50 percent
declared_before_running.sharpe_convention: weekly returns annualised by sqrt(52). The dashboard's 2.77 tile is computed from daily returns and is not directly comparable; the weekly figure for the same book and window is 3.10.
declared_before_running.trend_sleeve: Step 201 sleeve at its lowest leverage setting with Rogers-Satchell sizing from Step 207

not_claimed: The composite CONTAINS the sector ensemble. This is not a rival stock-selection strategy that beats it; it is a portfolio that holds it alongside others. Any framing of 'a better strategy was found' would misrepresent what was done.
Both books are measured on the window they were selected in. Neither figure is forward evidence.
